items.prompt:
To come PREPARED to a discussion, you should:
A) read the material and bring ideas
B) show up with nothing
C) read something unrelated
items.answer: A) read the material and bring ideas

steps: Get ready ahead. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) read the material and bring ideas

items.prompt:
When a classmate is talking, you should:
A) listen
B) talk over them
C) leave

steps: Listen to others. Key is A.

items.prompt:
To deepen a discussion, you should:
A) pose and respond to questions
B) stay silent and confused
C) change the subject
items.answer: A) pose and respond to questions

steps: Ask/answer to go deeper. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) pose and respond to questions

items.prompt:
A classmate makes a point; you say, 'Good point, and it connects to the theme of courage.' You are:
A) contributing and building on their idea
B) ignoring them
C) changing the topic
items.answer: A) contributing and building on their idea

steps: Linking and adding. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) contributing and building on their idea

items.prompt:
Which shows you are following discussion RULES and roles?
A) taking turns and carrying out your role
B) interrupting constantly
C) doing an unrelated task
items.answer: A) taking turns and carrying out your role

steps: Rules and roles. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) taking turns and carrying out your role

items.prompt:
At the END of a discussion, reviewing the key ideas helps the group:
A) remember and conclude what was learned
B) forget everything
C) start over randomly
items.answer: A) remember and conclude what was learned

steps: Summarize the discussion. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) remember and conclude what was learned

items.prompt:
Which response BEST contributes to a discussion?
A) 'You said the character was selfish. Building on that, in chapter 3 he refused to share, which supports the theme that selfishness leads to loneliness.'
B) 'Anyway, I like pizza.'
C) 'No, you're wrong.'
items.answer: A) 'You said the character was selfish. Building on that, in chapter 3 he refused to share, which supports the theme that selfishness leads to loneliness.'

steps: Links, adds evidence, connects to theme. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) 'You said the character was selfish. Building on that, in chapter 3 he refused to share, which supports the theme that selfishness leads to loneliness.'

items.prompt:
Why is coming prepared with EVIDENCE important in a discussion?
A) You can support your points and build on others' ideas with specifics
B) So you can talk first
C) It is not important
items.answer: A) You can support your points and build on others' ideas with specifics

steps: Evidence strengthens contributions. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) You can support your points and build on others' ideas with specifics
